recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-contrast studio portrait of a man wearing a red velvet Santa hat and a black formal bow tie, set against a stark, off-white background. The subject is cropped at the collar, creating a floating-head effect that emphasizes facial expression and festive accessories.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the deep red velvet of the hat and the stark white background
Juxtaposition of formal evening wear (bow tie) with whimsical holiday headwear
Texture interplay between the fluffy white faux fur and the smooth skin tones
Symmetrical balance of the face anchored by the sharp angles of the bow tie
coreInvariants: Red velvet Santa hat with a white fur trim and pom-pom
Black silk or satin bow tie
Direct, warm studio lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, medium-close-up crop focusing on the head and neck area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the knot of the bow tie create a vertical central axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright red hat, moves down to the facial expression, and rests on the sharp black bow tie.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive off-white space surrounding the subject to isolate the figure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white background provides a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red of the hat and black of the bow tie provide high-value contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and subtle highlights in the velvet.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red hat against low-saturation background and neutral black/white elements.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, black, white, and natural skin tones

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution studio portrait of a man with a warm expression, wearing a red velvet Santa hat with white fur trim and a black bow tie. Use a solid off-white background. Ensure the lighting is soft and professional, highlighting the textures of the velvet and fur.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a clean serif or elegant script in black or gold, positioned in the negative space around the head.

verificationChecks: Is the background a clean, solid off-white?
Is the Santa hat texture visibly velvet?
Is the bow tie sharp and black?
Is the subject isolated without a visible torso?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the Santa hat's tail
Specific shade of the off-white background
mustRedesign: Avoid any visible clothing other than the white shirt collar and bow tie
Ensure the pom-pom of the hat does not overlap with the face
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic fur texture on the hat trim.
Verify the bow tie is perfectly centered under the chin.
Ensure the background is free of gradients or noise.
Confirm the red of the hat is vibrant but deep.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + [Subject Description] + Santa hat + black bow tie + off-white minimalist background + high-texture detail.
